reason: The repository is a collection of DeepSeek Harness integration components, centered on plugin development and adaptation, including a desktop shell, Git auto-initialization plugin, environment scripts, and engineering workflow skills.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的开源集成集合，提供桌面壳、Git 自动初始化插件、环境适配脚本和工程流程技能。
summaries.en: An open-source DeepSeek Harness integration collection providing a desktop shell, Git auto-initialization plugin, environment scripts, and engineering workflow skills.

capabilities: Provides a DSH desktop shell with attach and spawn modes
Automatically initializes Git repositories and may create default .gitignore files
Provides engineering workflow skills for planning, testing, debugging, research, and code review
Runs environment-adaptation scripts and records desktop process information locally
